No timer started on registration alone, and no retrofit timer after completed start.

start NONASYNC: check disposed FIRST and synchronously throw NEW Error('NodeProviderConfigRuntime 已 dispose'); if cached start Promise exists return SAME exact Promise forever on success including concurrent calls. Otherwise call this.configService.read() and attach .then, no async wrapper. Sync read/then error propagates, no cached Promise. Save resulting promise, attach rejection observer: clear start slot ONLY if still same Promise; do not wrap/change caller Promise or swallow caller rejection. On successful read continuation: if disposed return without background/timer. Else call background check immediately fire-and-forget BEFORE deciding timer gate. Gate is remote synchronizer present OR source instanceof EndpointScopedKnorviaBuiltinSource OR check-listener Set currently nonempty; if any create GLOBAL setInterval(callback,60000) whose callback fire-and-forgets background check. Store handle, invoke handle.unref?.() with native receiver when present. Plain managed no-remote/no-listener worker starts one immediate skipped background round but NO interval. Timers/global dependencies may throw natively; don't add catch/rollback. Return exact start Promise without awaiting background completion.

refreshKnorviaBuiltin NONASYNC optional {force?}: if disposed return new resolved Promise('disposed'). If source instanceof Endpoint... delegate refresh(options) exact Promise with same optional options ref, including undefined. Otherwise return remoteSynchronizer?.refresh(options) exact Promise if present, else new resolved Promise('skipped'). No options validation/default change or synchronous-error conversion.

Background checks: if disposed return new resolved Promise<void>; if in-flight check exists return same. Start refreshKnorviaBuiltin() synchronously FIRST then take SNAPSHOT [...liveListenerSet]; schedule each captured listener via Promise.resolve().then(listener), passing undefined, not binding runtime receiver. A sync refresh throw escapes before any check-slot assignment; don't catch it. Promise.allSettled over refresh first then listener promises; concurrent checks coalesce to one stored returned chained Promise. After settled: if disposed suppress all reporting; else iterate results in input order, for each rejected invoke stored onRemoteRefreshError?.(exact reason) with runtime as its private-field member receiver. No event object/error wrapping, no exception catch around callback; native callback throw rejects check (existing fire-and-forget limitation). Finally clear check slot only if same Promise; don't add timeout/retry/per-check cancellation/another state/write path. Listener snapshot semantics: add/remove during a round affect later rounds only. Registration during synchronous refresh occurs before snapshot; registration during listener microtasks doesn't enter that round.

Dispose sync/idempotent: if disposed return; commit disposed=true FIRST. If timer handle truthy clearInterval(handle); then set timer null, clear listener Set, remoteSynchronizer?.dispose(), configService.dispose(), personalRepository.dispose(), builtinSource.dispose() in THAT order. Native clear/disposer throws stop later teardown; no rollback/retry, later dispose no-op. Don't clear/reset start/check Promises, install a new timer, cancel callbacks beyond delegated dependencies or wait for background completion. Started/read/refresh in-flight continues through its existing Promise; successful read after disposed suppresses timer/background, and late background settlements suppress error reporting.
